The '''Sphere of Laws and Justice''', also known as the '''Ministry of Laws and Justice''' and the '''Pyramid of Laws and Justice''', was one of twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Founded in [[4980 BBY]], the Sphere was controlled by a member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]], and oversaw the Empire's internal law enforcement and judicial systems.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Mortis]] headed the Sphere.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In his role as head of the Sphere, Mortis sent his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Zavrasha]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to ensure that the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military's]] actions there did not endanger the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] with the Republic.<ref name="Shattering">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Shattering the Peace|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the sphere was combined with the [[Sphere of Production and Logistics]] into the [[Sphere of Civil Administration]] by Empress [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="SOTG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sphere of Laws and Justice was introduced in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', in the section on the Spheres of Influence.
